column1: # tools/minittl_rules.py. Pages: r1 MINITTL1 0x55000 (copy in 5), r2a/r2b
# MINITTL2 0x55000/0x91800 (6), r3 MINITTL3 (7), r4 MINITTL4 (8), r9
# MINITTL9 (B), rA MINITTLA (C). Same scheme as the first game's
# data/fest_pics.tsv; rects measured on this disc (private/re/minittl/).
# x,y,w,h: box over the JP text (body/label: the ink, heading: the glyphs,
#   header: the glyphs on the band, plate: the grey plate, back: 戻る).
# kind: header (rainbow title on the band), heading (on an ellipse), body,
#   label (small text by an icon), plate (grey label plate), back.
# fill: text colour; heading: two colours a>b for the glyph gradient.
# notes: num@ (numbered circle, kept), icon@ (button icon; kept, or moved
#   when the EN text names it as {i0}, {i1}...), botan@ (small caption under
#   an icon, erased), plate@ (L1/R1 plate, kept), area@x0,y0,x1,y1 (where
#   the EN text may go; default: the box).
